title: $\mathrm M$-Eigenpairs of Partially Symmetric Tensors: Exact Reformulation and Perturbation Bounds
summary: In this paper, we consider the computation of $M$-eigenpairs of fourth order partially symmetric tensors arising from elasticity theory. First, a lifted fourth order tensor is constructed, and the original $M$-eigenvalue problem is reformulated as a parameterized generalized tensor eigenvalue problem under the $\mathbf B_{α,β}$-normalization. Then, an exact correspondence between the two eigenvalue problems is established, which provides a procedure for computing all real $M$-eigenpairs through the proposed reformulation.
